## F — Identity, residency and applicant requirements
Research index: 37 original C facts and 43 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Identity, residency and applicant requirements.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-APPLICANT-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-APPLICANT-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-APPLICANT-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-APPLICANT-DYNAMIC — Current document acceptance lists and links, donor contribution amounts and service contacts need an official refresh before use as live application guidance.
VERIFY: ID-APPLICANT-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-APPLICANT-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
VERIFY: ID-APPLICANT-CITIZENSHIP-LIST — The checklist on physical page twenty-one lists proof of citizenship alongside lawful-presence documents; preserve the noncitizen eligibility rules on later pages rather than treating citizenship as universally mandatory.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
